# function: mobiletargeting_journey_metrics

Builds the ARN for `mobiletargeting` `journey-metrics`:

```
arn:${Partition}:mobiletargeting:${Region}:${Account}:apps/${AppId}/journeys/${JourneyId}/kpis/daterange/${KpiName}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:mobiletargeting:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:apps/app-id/journeys/journey-id/kpis/daterange/kpi-name
output "mobiletargeting_journey_metrics" {
  value = provider::arn::mobiletargeting_journey_metrics("app-id", "journey-id", "kpi-name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
mobiletargeting_journey_metrics(app_id string, journey_id string, kpi_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `app_id` (String) Value for `${AppId}` in the ARN template.
1. `journey_id` (String) Value for `${JourneyId}` in the ARN template.
1. `kpi_name` (String) Value for `${KpiName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
